title: Matsuno Wellness Celebrates 27 Years of Transformative Bodywork | User | theeveningleader.com
text:
Founder Bruce Matsuno Marks Nearly Three Decades of Excellence in Massage Therapy and Structural Integration Matsuno Wellness , a premier therapeutic bodywork practice in North Texas, proudly celebrates 27 years of service to the Plano community and surrounding areas. Founded by Bruce Matsuno, the practice has established itself as a trusted destination for those seeking relief from chronic pain and improved physical wellness through advanced massage therapy and structural integration techniques.
Since founding his practice in 1998, Bruce Matsuno has dedicated his career to helping clients achieve optimal physical alignment, pain reduction, and enhanced well-being. His unique approach combines traditional massage therapy with the principles of structural integration, addressing not just symptoms but the underlying structural causes of physical discomfort.
"When I began this journey 27 years ago, my goal was to offer something beyond standard massage," says Matsuno. "I wanted to create lasting change in people's bodies and lives. It's been incredibly rewarding to see thousands of clients experience transformative results over the years."
Matsuno's commitment to excellence has earned him a loyal client base ranging from professional athletes to office workers suffering from chronic pain conditions. His specialized techniques have proven particularly effective for addressing issues such as persistent back pain, postural imbalances, and recovery from injuries.
The practice, conveniently located at 2500 Dallas Parkway, Suite 111 in Plano, has become known for its holistic approach to bodywork. Unlike conventional massage services, Matsuno Wellness focuses on education and progressive improvement, helping clients understand their bodies and participate actively in their healing journey.
"Bruce has a gift for understanding the body's interconnected systems," says longtime client Sarah Richardson. "After years of back pain and limited mobility, his structural integration approach gave me my active lifestyle back. What sets him apart is that he doesn't just treat symptoms—he trains your body to maintain proper alignment."
To mark this milestone anniversary, Matsuno Wellness will be offering special anniversary packages throughout March for both new and returning clients. These commemorative offerings are designed to introduce more people to the benefits of structural integration and celebrate the practice's contribution to wellness in the North Texas community.
For more information about Matsuno Wellness, its approach to therapeutic bodywork, or to schedule a consultation, visit https://matsunowellness.com/ or call the office directly.
About Matsuno Wellness
Founded in 1998, Matsuno Wellness provides specialized massage therapy and structural integration services in Plano, Texas. Under the direction of founder Bruce Matsuno, the practice focuses on creating lasting improvements in posture, mobility, and pain reduction through advanced bodywork techniques. Located at 2500 Dallas Parkway, Suite 111, Plano, TX 75093, Matsuno Wellness serves clients throughout the North Texas region with a commitment to excellence and personalized care.
